Package net.jandie1505.datastorage

Klasse DataStorage

java.lang.Object
net.jandie1505.datastorage.DataStorage
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Iterable<Map.Entry<String,Object>>
public class DataStorage extends Object implements Iterable<Map.Entry<String,Object>>
A DataStorage stores data.
It is way more restricted, but that makes it easier to manage the values.
DataStorage can only save primitive types and strings. All other specified objects will be converted to strings.
DataStorage uses a section format, which means Section1.Section2.Section3. Section2 is a subsection of Section1. Subsections can be extracted, sections can be merged into this DataStorage as subsections or directly.
